label.purpose: Section eyebrows, form labels, footer legal links, numbering.

shadows.name: cta-mobile
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA buttons on mobile only; removed at md:.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default CTA button; full-width with a soft shadow on mobile, auto-width and flat on desktop.
components.css: .btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; background: #2a42bb; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; transition: background-color 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .btn-primary:hover { background: #465cd4; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .btn-primary { box-shadow: none; width: auto; } }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Numbered mono label preceding every section heading, e.g. '02 / Diagnóstico'. Short label on mobile, long label on desktop.
components.css: .eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #757685; } .eyebrow-number { color: #465cd4; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard bordered card; alternates surface/warm-paper-tint background between siblings for rhythm instead of shadow or accent borders.

narrative.overview: This is the visual language of a confidential consulting report handed to an executive before they approve spend: warm paper, near-square corners, one reserved signal color, and a mono-typed numbering system that indexes every section like a document outline. The system is restrained and credible, closer to editorial and print-report conventions than to SaaS marketing, and explicitly rejects the generic AI-generated-site look: no gradients, no floating blobs, no glossy stock-photo hero treatments, no soft glowing shadows standing in for structure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper background with a single reserved indigo signal color.
Near-square 2px corners everywhere; no larger radii.
Flat by default; shadow only as a mobile-only CTA affordance.
A recurring 'NN / label' mono eyebrow indexes every major section.
Alternating warm-tint and white card backgrounds create rhythm without borders or shadows.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo appears on at most one interactive element's worth of attention per view. It is never a decorative fill, gradient, or background wash.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are always 1px line color. A thicker or differently colored border on a card, list item, or callout is a deviation, not a variant.

rules.name: The Numbered Index Rule
rules.body: Every major section opens with a NN / label mono eyebrow via the shared SectionEyebrow component. The numbering is sequential and meaningful, mirroring a report's table of contents.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only where an element must visually detach from page flow (a floating popover, a mobile-only tap target), never as ambient card styling.

dos: Do keep every border at the 1px line hairline.
Do use rounded-[2px] on every card, button, panel, and input.
Do alternate surface / warm-paper-tint backgrounds between sibling cards for rhythm.
Do keep Signal Indigo reserved for the single most important action or link on a view.
Do keep the mobile CTA shadow but remove it at md: breakpoint.
donts: Don't add a thick single-side accent border (border-l-4, border-t-2) to a card, list item, or callout.
Don't combine a colored accent border with rounded-[2px] corners.
Don't introduce shadows as ambient card depth.
Don't fabricate testimonials, customer logos, or benchmark numbers.
